Essential: Bachelors Degree from a recognized University / Institution; two years experience in administration or establishment or Court matters. Service: (i) holding analogous post on regular basis; or (ii) six years service in the grade on a regular basis in posts in level-5 (Rs. 29200 -92300) or equivalent; or (iii) ten years service in the grade on a regular basis in posts in level-4 (Rs. 25500 – 81100) or equivalent. Service: (i) holding analogous post on regular basis; or (ii) ten years regular service in level-4 (Rs. 25500 - Rs. 81100) in the Pay Matrix or equivalent. | Who can apply: Officers under Central Government or State Governments or Union territory Administrations or courts or tribunals or autonomous bodies or statutory organisation or public sector undertakings or recognised university or research institution. Service: (i) holding analogous post on a regular basis; or (ii) six years regular service in level-5 (Rs. 29200 – 92300); or (iii) ten years regular service in level-4 (Rs. 25500 – 81100), in the Pay Matrix or equivalent. salary_details.details: The notice does not mention allowances or the in-hand salary. Other service conditions will be governed by the Recruitment Rules notified or to be notified.

selection_process: Positions will be filled based on merit cum first cum first receipt basis. Applications received and found complete in all respects will be considered for selection periodically for the remaining available vacancies. The Department of Revenue reserves the right to post suitable applicants in any bench out of the three preferences given by the applicant
subject to the availability of vacancy in the posts applied for.
how_to_apply: Open the online application portal at https://gstn.org.in/gstat-application. The link will be active from 15 November 2026. The vacancy circular, proforma and application link are also hosted at dor.gov.in/gstat-recruitment.
Fill in the application in the proforma given in Annexure 2 and Annexure 3, with the requisite attachments.
Choose three bench preferences in the "Location applying for" field.
Submit the application through the online portal within 30 days from 15 November 2026, i.e. before 15 December 2026.
Send a copy of your application to your Cadre Controlling Authority.

The Cadre Controlling Authority forwards the application in the Annexure 3 proforma, with photocopies of APARs/ACRs of the last five years attested by an officer not below the rank of Under Secretary to the Government of India, to the Under Secretary, Ad.1C Branch, Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance, Kartavya Bhawan-1, New Delhi-110001 (also at [email protected]). This must be done within 15 days from the date it receives the application.
Officers already on deputation must have their application forwarded by the parent cadre or department, along with Cadre Clearance, Vigilance Clearance and an integrity certificate.
A photograph and three bench preferences, chosen from a drop-down list.
The date of entry into government service and the date of retirement as per parent cadre rules.
A clear statement on whether you meet the requisite essential qualification and work experience.
Employment details in chronological order (office, post held, from, to, scale of pay, nature of appointment). Attach a separate sheet if needed.

The nature of present employment (ad-hoc, temporary, quasi-permanent or permanent), deputation or contract details where applicable, any past deputation with the date of return, and whether you work under the Central Government, a State Government or another employer.
A signed declaration that the information is correct and that no material fact has been suppressed.
Photocopies of APARs/ACRs of the last five years, attested by an officer not below the rank of Under Secretary to the Government of India (sent by the Cadre Controlling Authority).
Cadre Clearance, Vigilance Clearance and integrity certificate (for officers already on deputation).
important_instructions: Candidates once selected will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature subsequently on any ground. All fields in the application proforma/checklist are mandatory. An incomplete application will not be considered and will be rejected without any intimation. Deputation period, Sl. No. 2, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11 and 12 (Joint Registrar, Assistant Registrar, Senior Private Secretary, Senior Accounts Officer, Court Officer, Private Secretary, Accountant, Stenographer Grade I and Assistant): ordinarily not exceeding three years. Deputation period, Sl. No. 3 and 4 (Deputy Registrar and Principal Private Secretary): ordinarily not exceeding four years. Deputation period, Sl. No. 1 and 13 (Financial Advisor and Upper Division Clerk): ordinarily not exceeding five years. Each deputation period includes any deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately before this appointment. It may be curtailed depending on the officer's performance and organisational requirement, and may be extended or curtailed in case of administrative exigencies. Pay-band and grade pay granted under ACP/MACP are personal to the officer and should not be mentioned as the pay of the post. Only the pay of the post held on regular basis is to be given; ACP/MACP details go in the separate space on the form. For officers holding a post on deputation outside the cadre while keeping a lien in the parent cadre, the deputation details (parent office and substantive post and pay) must be given in all cases. The vacancy circular invites fresh applications in continuation of the department's vacancy circulars dated 14.09.2024 and 14.08.2025.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in GSTAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 237 posts across 13 grades, the largest being Stenographer Grade I (59) and Court Officer (56). All counts are tentative and subject to variation dependent on workload.

faq.question: Q2. When does the GSTAT 2026 online application start?
faq.answer: The online application link at gstn.org.in/gstat-application will be active from 15 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for GSTAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted within 30 days from 15 November 2026, i.e. before 15 December 2026. The cut-off date for eligibility is 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for GSTAT deputation posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age is fifty-six years for posts at Sl. No. 1 to 12 and fifty-eight years for Upper Division Clerk, as on the closing date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is required for GSTAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Most posts need a Bachelor's degree with experience; for example, Court Officer needs a Bachelors Degree and two years experience in administration or establishment or Court matters. Senior Private Secretary, Private Secretary, Stenographer Grade I and Upper Division Clerk have only service conditions.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for GSTAT posts?
faq.answer: Pay ranges from Level-4 (Rs.25500 - 81100) for Upper Division Clerk to Level-13 (Rs.123100 - 215900) for Financial Advisor. Court Officer and Senior Private Secretary are at Level-8 (Rs.47600 - 151100).

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for GSTAT 2026?
faq.answer: Positions will be filled based on merit cum first cum first receipt basis. Complete applications are considered periodically for the remaining available vacancies.

faq.question: Q8. Who can apply for GSTAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only serving officers and officials of the Central Government, State Governments, Union Territories or Tribunals can apply, along with other bodies listed for some posts. Each applicant must hold an analogous post or have the prescribed regular service in a lower pay level.

faq.question: Q9. How long is the deputation period in GSTAT?
faq.answer: The deputation period is ordinarily not more than three years for most posts, four years for Deputy Registrar and Principal Private Secretary, and five years for Financial Advisor and Upper Division Clerk. It may be curtailed, or extended or curtailed in administrative exigencies.

faq.question: Q10. Can a selected candidate withdraw from GSTAT deputation?
faq.answer: No. Candidates once selected will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature subsequently on any ground.
